message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  Roughly:

| Side | Casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|----------------------------------------|
| Allied (British, Dutch‑German, Prussian) | ~23 000 |
| French | ~25 000 |

**Total casualties:** about **48 000** soldiers.  

These figures include those killed, wounded, and taken prisoner or missing. The numbers vary slightly among sources, but the consensus places the total around 45–50 000.
